claims.statement: M0-FC40 (37.50%) surpasses the published Ticktack paper performance.
claims.rationale: Paper reported 64.96% on Qwen2.5-3B and 74.29% on Qwen2.5-7B on their full TempUN test split. M0-FC40 is 0.5B, evaluated on an exploratory 24-case diagnostic subset of TempUN Small. Numerically and methodologically non-comparable.

claims.statement: M0-FC40 demonstrates a significant accuracy gain over the base model on the 24-case diagnostic subset under P12.
claims.rationale: Under identical P12 evaluation on the 24 diagnostic cases, the frozen base Qwen2.5-0.5B achieved 41.67% (10/24), whereas M0-FC40 achieved 37.50% (9/24), a difference of -4.17 percentage points. No gain is demonstrated.

claims.statement: Task-Aware protocol P12 restores syntax compliance and eliminates prompt interference compared to P11.
claims.rationale: First-token logits analysis confirms P12 shifts 92.9% probability mass back to option letters {a,b,c,d}, reducing invalid syntax rate from 66.7% to 0.0% on the diagnostic subset.

claims.statement: M0-FC40 3-seed checkpoints are 100% numerically stable and finite.
claims.rationale: All 9 checkpoints contain 0 NaN / 0 Inf across 3,383,041 parameters (13,708,711 bytes each), verified by independent hash audit.
